Callout.Name: Drug Deal in Progress
Callout.Message: Drug deal in progress in an alley, caller watching.

Script.Line: I was buying. Buying is not dealing.
It is a small amount. Look at it, it is a small amount.
I am not saying where I got it. I am not saying that.

Lines.Approach: Two males in the alley, second exchange in ten minutes.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
